title: GS Fighter III
tagline: Fourteen fighters in full 3D. Arcade, Training and a full Player Menu.
description: GS Fighter III in the browser: Akeem, Nika and twelve newcomers on the painted Diamond Crest fighter select, each with their own V-Wave color (Cyborg fires the Arc Lance). New in 1.3: the Player Menu pauses the match with fighter info, a Move Guide that plays each move's real animation beside its inputs, and full Options for controls, gameplay, audio and video. Training mode gives you a passive dummy and an endless clock. Arcade is best of three against a CPU from Easy to Ferocious. Touch, keyboard or controller with rumble.
